title: Certify that uniform P104 completion misses a port-dependent chart.
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Partial certificate. No new κ. Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`.

On address space `(F_2)^4`, with `C_u = ((1+i)I + (1-i)X_u)/2`:

- `C_0 = I`. For `u ≠ 0`, `C_u` acts by `i` on an odd half of size 8, and `X_u - X_v` differs on exactly 8 characters when `u ≠ v`.
- The same chart on both banks fixes every character-diagonal encoding. Exit `C_u` matches entrance `C_u`.
- Exit `C_u` for `u ≠ 0` does not match entrance `C_0`. `F T^{-1}` acts by `-i` on the odd half, not by `1`. All 15 nonzero labels fail. One data role already fails the every-role condition. Helper roles are not in the model.
- In ordered coordinates, `PL - LP = [[-H, 0], [K(D-I), H]]` when `H` commutes with `T` and `K = T^{-1}`. With `H = I`, the first-bank image of `(A, 0)` is `-A`. The literal factor `-T^{-1}` acts by `i` on the odd character, not by `-1`. The bookkeeping permutation `Pi` is not applied.
- The published scaffold arithmetic is reproduced and not re-proved: lower mass `3009344`, capacity `2965248`, excess `44096`. At `a = 0` the ratio is already greater than 1.

This does not construct an adjacent completed-call pair, a chronological correction, or a supplier.

## Task and overlap

- Base: `bb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f` (canonical `CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds` main, priority revision 6).
- Head: `281ce601a8be9db470de630759179c23e1dfaa88`.
- Task: `p104-side-correction`, scope **changed**. The card asks for a chronological correction program. Eligible handoffs on #1166, after dropping delivered work and open PRs through #4123, numbered 12. Item index `(18-1) mod 12 = 5` (0-based) is comment 19034066, the adjacent completed-call pair. This package does not build that pair. It certifies the uniform-commutation gap the request says is not a matched caller.
- Handoff: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19034066
- Predecessor formulas and scaffold integers: PR #3954, not imported.
- Not redone: the pair search, helper roles, PR #3954 hypotheses (a)–(e), or a κ calculation.

Ordered eligible handoffs used for this index, chronological on #1166 from comment 19016211 through 2026-10-20T02:32Z. A comment is kept when it states a smallest/next useful task that is not performed by an open PR numbered at most 4123 and is not in this round's delivered set. One comment, one item. Later text on the same thread replaces the earlier task.

1. Single-hub two-bearing factorization of PR #3573 (comment 19021149).
2. QQ16 adjacent event pair after the delivered F0 bind (comment 19030049; the bind itself is #4114).
3. Integer-shear payload subspace and dirty return (comment 19032401, replacing 19031016).
4. Independent review of the #3942 interaction reduction (comment 19032637, task 1).
5. Match the #3943 legacy-return adapter with #3940 (comment 19032700, task 1).
6. Adjacent completed-call pair (comment 19034066). **This session refines a different piece of that request.**
7. Chronological row/column tag reconciliation (comment 19034676).
8. Source-normalization fusion caller (comment 19035513).
9. Literal-index-to-tensor bridge (comment 19035716).
10. One physical K/adjoint/frame boundary (comment 19036235).
11. Hypothesis separating the three legal R439 words from the synthetic edge (comment 19056041).
12. Smaller V45 joint witness among the 29 role edits (comment 19056155).

Dropped before that list: the #3605 full wrapper (open #3681), typed actual-width H (#4123), the L22 split census after its cheap pair step (#4117), the residual consumer (open #3943), the T385 wrapper (open #3936), neutral-first retiming (open #3941), tensor-pairing review (#4113), moved-ADD (#4122), and separated A2 acceptance (#4112).

## Validation

CPython 3.12.3. Registered replay:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-uniform-commutation-gap
```

Passed locally as `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p104-uniform-commutation-gap outcome=partial`. Both the normal command and `-O` print `PASS_P104_UNIFORM_COMMUTATION_GAP`. Failures are raised exceptions, so `-O` does not skip them.

Not run: `check_research_commit.py --check-source-history` (this clone has no full Git history), Lean, Docker, a selected cold replay, and any search for a matching pair.

## Credit

Chris R / Clear1nsight, PR #3954, for the ordered encoding, the commutator, and the scaffold integers. Discussion #1166 comment 19034066 for the adjacent-pair request and the warning that uniform commutation is not that pair. Rohan Arun, Chafik Boukhalfa, and Adam Gall retain the lineage named there.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. No independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. Is there one adjacent pair, port-dependent charts allowed, whose exit matches the next entrance on every data role and every helper role? First step: write the charts on one data line and its helper block. Blocker: this model has no helper roles and does not search pairs.
2. Do hypotheses (a)–(e) of the published 44,096-excess scaffold hold for one actual producer? First step: bind one local call to mass 2,576 and progress 2,312. Blocker: those hypotheses were not replayed.
